verdicts.reason: A has a clean top-to-bottom order (headline, product, CTA) that suits the portrait canvas, but the Q logo is shrunk to a tiny, nearly illegible mark in the footer and the sticker is shrunk to a thumbnail next to the legal line, so the brand is weakened. B puts the product and headline side by side, which wastes the format: there is about 230px of empty space at the top and a large dead gap above the footer. Its three-line headline and small CTA are cramped into the right column, and the logo and sticker are pushed down beside the fine print.
